name: Triopticon Sanmei
source:
Detective Yu-chi Fang discovered that the anomaly at the crime scene was related to his own hidden secret. What is abnormal and what is normal? In the end, Yu-chi Fang must face his true feelings and make a choice.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023990/Triopticon/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
刑警方煜奇发现，案发现场的异常竟与自己隐藏的秘密有关。何为异常，何为正常？最终，方煜奇必须直面自己的真实心意，作出选择。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023990/Triopticon/]Steam[/url]]
